en: Yes. It's for their own good.
Y'think? Okay, I'll do it! Next time I see them, I'm gonna let 'em know what's up!
But I wonder if they'll even believe me. What if they just think I'm trash-talkin' their man?
Don't worry. These people have followed your advice before, right? They'll do it again.
If you think so, then I'm sure that's how things'll turn out. Thanks a bunch, Kiryu-san!
Good point. Seeing as you already gave them the go-ahead before, they may not listen now.
So I shouldn't say nothing?
Maybe not.
Geez, be serious for a sec! I'm tryin' t'get some advice and ya ain't givin' me a straight answer!
Ah, sorry.
No, don't. You might just complicate things more. Nothing's happened yet, so you're better off watching over them for now.
That's true. It's not like they've already been scammed.
Okay. I don't like any of this, but I'll just keep my eye on things for now.
That'd be for the best.
Tell them how?
How? Well, I'll say that Subaru's a bad man, and that he's trying to pull a fast one on 'em.
Do you have any proof of what he's doing?
Uh, well... Not exactly, no.
Then they're not going to take your word for it. Especially since they're in love with this guy. You need to look into this a little more.
Yeah, maybe you're right.
If you hadn't stopped me, I woulda just barged right on into things. Thanks for the advice.
Hey, no problem.
What's wrong? Something bothering you again?
So, when we were out walkin' earlier, we ran into that host I was telling ya about, right?
Yeah, I remember.
And I guess someone I know saw me, and figured I was tryin' to hit on him and stuff.
I suppose depending on what people saw, it might have looked like a fight between lovers.
Right, so when Asumi-chan heard about it, I guess she thought I was backstabbin' her and stuff.
And now she's going around sayin' I'm some kinda awful bitch.
I see. Guess things backfired on you, huh?
Yeah. Now I don't know what I oughta do.
Don't worry about it. It's just a misunderstanding. It'll clear up.
Well, I sure hope so.
Why not tell her what really happened?
She won't pick up the phone... And she ain't responding to any of my emails.
You think she's avoiding you?
Yeah. When she came to ask me for advice, she always made it a point to listen. But I guess she didn't really trust me after all.
Perhaps. I mean, you said it yourself, right? People who come for advice only want someone to listen to them talk about their situation.
Maybe they never actually came to you looking for advice in the first place.
Right. I guess deep down I kinda already knew that, but I got too caught up in wantin' to be someone folks could rely on.
It's good you realized that. From now on, you can be more modest and concentrate on earning real trust from others.
What? But I don't wanna wait 'til later on. Can't y'tell me what to do now?
Hm. Well, right now might be a bit tricky, you know? I think it's just going to take time.
Argh, this blows.
You still have a good heart.
Hm, y'think? How so?
You have a vision of who you want to be. It's important for you to be faithful to that vision. Do that, and a good reputation will follow.
Hmm. I guess that's one way to look at things. It's definitely not like me to get all caught up in what other folks think of me!
All righty, then! From here on out, I'm gonna try to be a better, more dependable Riku-san!
There, that's the spirit.
I don't think that's it. She's hurting because she trusted you, and she thinks you've betrayed her.
If you keep insisting on explaining yourself, eventually you'll get through to her.
Y'really think so?
Really, really?
Really, really.
No foolin'?
No fooling.
But how do y'know that for sure? You're not just tellin' me what I wanna hear, are ya? Don't just blow me off like that, okay!
I'm not, honest.
C'mon, I'm really serious about this.
Well, maybe. It's really all up to you, though.
If you put it that way, I'm not really confident about my answer.
What!? You're supposed to say everything is gonna be okay!
Oh. Then, everything will be okay.
Really. Now come on, how many times are you going to make me repeat it?
Ahaha. Sorry, it's kinda fun, that's all!
Besides, your words alone cheered me up. I won't give up, promise!
I went to talk to Asumi-chan, but just as I thought, she wouldn't hear me out.
You still haven't cleared up the misunderstanding?
Nope. I didn't think things would get this bad.
Don't give up. Eventually she'll see you're being sincere and hear you out.
Yeah, you're right! I can't just up and leave things hangin' like this!
Don't waste your time. She may be your friend, but you don't need this trouble.
I dunno. The thought of doing that kinda leaves a bad taste in my mouth. Ain't it better to try and be friends with her?
But that's what you're trying to do now, and all it's doing is running you ragged.
Yuka-chan's been avoiding me lately too. And apparently she's spreadin' rumors about me behind my back.
That's not good. If you let her get away with that, other people you know might turn against you.
Right. I gotta do somethin' about this.
Let her talk. No matter how much people might badmouth you, that doesn't mean you're a bad person.
But ain't that just gonna make things worse? I don't wanna give up and let the misunderstanding stand. I gotta do somethin'.
Do you have any ideas?
Hmm. I think trying to talk to those two any more than I already have is just gonna fall on deaf ears. I gotta do something about him instead.
Y'do? You really mean that, Kiryu-san?
Okay then.
Him who?
Y'know, Subaru-san!
Ah, right.
That settles it! Next time I go out, I'm gonna confront him! Even if I don't got proof, all I need is to get him to admit everything, right?
Right. That's the fastest way to settle this. But you said this guy has ties to the yakuza, right? Be sure to think carefully before you act.
I hear ya. I ain't gonna let the same kind of misunderstanding happen again. I'll be careful.
I gotta say, Kiryu-san, ya sure do seem to know what I'm thinking.
Well, you came to me for advice, so now I'm concerned about you. That's all.
You really are a stand-up guy, Kiryu-san. I'm glad I asked you for advice.
Heh. Sure.
You really shouldn't. You said this guy's mixed up with the yakuza, right? You don't want to mess with someone like that.
But I don't know what else I can do.
Hey now, I'm not going to leave you hanging.
You don't have to rush into this all alone. It's okay to ask for help. If things get bad, give me a call.
You mean it? You're the best, Kiryu-san! I'm so glad I asked you for advice!
Him? Who do you mean?
Who? But you... y'said ya knew what I meant!
No, I... Er...
I don't believe you! I've got a wicked serious problem here, and you're just noddin' your head and goin' "Yeah, sure, okay."
I'm never comin' to ya for help again!
Things with Counselor Riku are A-OK again! I cleared the air with Yuka-chan and Asumi-chan, and we're back to being friends like before!
That's good to hear. All's well that ends well.
This is all thanks to you, Kiryu-san.
Don't let it go to your head. If you're not careful in the future, this same sort of thing could happen again.
But hey, if you have a problem, Kiryu-san, y'can ask me for advice anytime, okay?
I do have quite a few. More than we could cover in one evening, really.
Don't mind that none, Kiryu-san! I'll listen to anything ya got that might be troublin' you.
Hey, all you're going to do is listen?
I don't really have any.
Well, if ya ever do, just keep me in mind, okay?
I might stop coming here before that happens.
Hey, ya can't do that! Kiryu-san, you meanie!
<Color:255,200,200,255>You've really got it together, Kiryu-san. And you speak so properly, too. I bet you're a real perfectionist at work.<Color:Default>
You could say that. I don't like leaving things half-done. I see things through to the end.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Aha. I figured as much.<Color:Default>
Is there a problem with that?
Not really. I'm only human, after all. I get careless and make mistakes just like anyone else does.
<Color:255,200,200,255>No way! Are you yankin' my chain?<Color:Default>
Why do you sound so happy about that?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I just like folks who aren't complete perfectionists.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>I dunno. I sorta like to poke my nose into things. And I like to help out folks with problems.<Color:Default>
That's very maternal of you.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I know, right? And my maternal instincts are sharp as a knife!<Color:Default>
Maybe I want you to mother me. It might be good for me to trust people sometimes.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh, I can't do that. I don't like it when men depend on me like I'm their mama. Makes ya kinda weak and all.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>When you've done all you can do by yourself, bring your troubles to ol' Riku here, and she'll help you out!<Color:Default>
I don't quite get you.
Do whatever you want. I'm not the kinda guy to ask a woman for advice.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Exactly! That's fine!<Color:Default>
What's good about that? Is it so wrong to make mistakes?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, then you'd just be a regular ol' good-for-nothing. I'd normally want you t'pull your own weight a bit more, ya know.<Color:Default>
That's... complicated.
Does that disqualify me?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Naw, 'course not. From what I can tell, you think you're almost perfect, but you're actually kinda loosey-goosey.<Color:Default>
And what of it?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I'm gonna find the cracks in your defenses, Kiryu-san! You'll slip up eventually, just y'wait!<Color:Default>
Heh. I'll be careful.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Really? Aw, that's too bad. A guy who's too perfect won't be liked by many people.<Color:Default>
Meaning guys like me?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Maaaybe. Hehehe. Does that make ya happy?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well then, Kiryu-san, y'just be your real self around me, okay?<Color:Default>
That's a difficult proposition.
<Color:255,200,200,255>There you go again, actin' all prim and proper again. But it's kinda nice.<Color:Default>
This is tiresome...
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hey, Kiryu-san. I'm a gal who's pretty popular with the boys, y'know.<Color:Default>
Sure. You give off that impression.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Really? I look like I'm a good catch?<Color:Default>
Whoa, hey. Modest much?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hey, it's true!<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>So I kinda have a problem with that.<Color:Default>
A problem?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah like, I know I can get a guy and all. That ain't the problem. It's keeping 'em where I run into trouble.<Color:Default>
I'm always the one getting dumped. Guys wind up leavin' me every time.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Am I just no good, do y'think?<Color:Default>
Maybe. If it keeps happening, there might be some kind of issue with you.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Y'really think so, huh? Like, I do my best to stay affectionate so the guy doesn't stop liking me and all, but it just keeps happenin'.<Color:Default>
That's your problem. Guys may think you're being too overbearing.
<Color:255,200,200,255>What? For real?<Color:Default>
Yeah. Maybe you should give them some space.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hm, I getcha. I'll try that next time I'm datin' someone. Speaking of which, I'm single now.<Color:Default>
Maybe that's not enough. These guys might be expecting a lot more affection than you're giving them.
<Color:255,200,200,255>What? But I already give 'em plenty! I can't give more than I already do!<Color:Default>
Men can be selfish creatures. We tend to want it all, you know.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hm. Guess I was right to ask a guy about my guy problems after all. Thanks for the advice, Kiryu-san!<Color:Default>
I don't think so. You're certainly attractive. The problem is probably with the guys.
<Color:255,200,200,255>What sorta problem?<Color:Default>
Well, I guess it depends on the individual.
<Color:255,200,200,255>But ain't it strange that all the guys I date wind up leaving me? The problem's gotta be with me, don't y'think?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oooh, you're no good at this sorta thing, Kiryu-san. I need someone willing to tell me the cold, hard truth.<Color:Default>
